items.q: What kind of projects does CORE829 develop?
items.a: We build full-stack web apps, custom sites, B2B automations, desktop/executable software and integrated AI solutions. We cover the whole cycle: design, development, deployment and marketing.

items.q: How long does a project take on average?
items.a: It depends on the scope. The most common projects (sites and web apps) take 4 to 12 weeks. We define clear timelines and milestones during the quoting phase.

items.q: Do you work with companies outside Italy?
items.a: Yes. We work fully online with clients across Europe. We are legally registered in Romania and operate in English and other languages.

items.q: Do you offer maintenance after launch?
items.a: Yes. Every project can include a maintenance plan: monitoring, updates, backups and continuous improvements. It's optional and agreed with the client.

items.q: How does a quote request work?
items.a: Fill out the contact form with a description of your project. We reply within 24-48 working hours with a first overview, then we schedule a discovery call.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains how CORE829 SRL collects, uses and protects personal data, in full compliance with the GDPR (EU Regulation 2016/679) and Romanian Law no. 190/2018 on personal data protection. This policy applies to the website core829.net and to all services offered by CORE829 SRL.

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
sections.body:
CORE829 SRL, with registered office at Str. Mihai Eminescu, 10, Roman, Romania, registered with the Trade Register under no. J2026029428009, CUI/CIF 54616345, is the data controller for the personal data processed through this website and through its services, in accordance with Art. 4(7) GDPR.
You can contact the controller by email at hello@core829.net or by telephone at +40 766 668 482 / +39 375 946 8881.

sections.title: 2. Data we collect
3. Purposes of processing
4. Legal basis
5. Recipients and data processors
6. International transfers
sections.body: We do not transfer your personal data outside the European Economic Area (EEA). Where third-party service providers process data on our behalf, they are bound by appropriate data processing agreements and, where a transfer outside the EEA occurs, by appropriate safeguards under Chapter V of the GDPR.

sections.title: 7. Data retention
sections.body:
Personal data collected through the forms is retained only for the time necessary to respond to requests and manage any contractual relationship, and in any case no longer than required by law.
Accounting and fiscal data are retained for the periods required by applicable law. At the end of the retention period, the data is securely deleted or anonymised.

sections.title: 8. Your rights
9. Data security
sections.body: We implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorised access, alteration, disclosure or destruction, in accordance with Art. 32 GDPR. These measures include secure communications (HTTPS), access controls and periodic reviews of our security practices.

sections.title: 10. Changes to this policy
sections.body: This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. Any change will be published on this page with the updated date. We invite you to review this page periodically.

sections.title: 11. Complaints
sections.body: If you believe that the processing of your personal data violates the GDPR, you have the right to lodge a complaint with the Romanian National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing (ANSPDCP), Str. G-ral Gheorghe Magheru 28-30, Bucharest, Romania, or with the supervisory authority of your place of residence.

terms.intro: These Terms of Service govern the use of the website core829.net and of the services offered by CORE829 SRL. By accessing the website or requesting any service, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the website or its services.

Contact: hello@core829.net — +40 766 668 482 / +39 375 946 8881.

sections.title: 2. Acceptance of terms
sections.body: By accessing the website, requesting a quote or accepting a proposal, you confirm that you have read, understood and accepted these Terms of Service. Specific projects are further governed by a separate written agreement signed by both parties, which prevails over these general terms in case of conflict.

sections.title: 3. Services offered

sections.body: Quotes are valid for the period indicated in the quote itself. A project starts only upon written acceptance of the quote and, where applicable, upon signing of the specific project agreement. Prices, scope and delivery times are those indicated in the accepted quote. Any change of scope requested after acceptance is subject to a new written estimate.

sections.title: 5. Payments
sections.body: Payment terms, amounts and milestones are those indicated in the accepted quote or project agreement. Unless otherwise agreed, projects require an advance payment and subsequent milestones. Invoices are payable within the term indicated on the invoice. Late payments may result in the suspension of the services until the outstanding amount is settled.

sections.title: 6. Client obligations
sections.body: The client agrees to provide, in a timely manner, all information, content, access and feedback necessary for the delivery of the services. Delays caused by the client may extend the agreed delivery times. The client guarantees that all content and materials it provides do not infringe the rights of third parties.

sections.title: 7. Delivery and acceptance
sections.body: Deliverables are considered accepted when the client confirms acceptance in writing or uses the deliverable in production without objection within the period indicated in the agreement. After acceptance, change requests are treated as new work subject to a separate estimate.

sections.title: 8. Intellectual property

Unless otherwise agreed in writing, upon full payment the client acquires the rights to the deliverables expressly produced for it, as defined in the project agreement. The technologies, frameworks, methodologies and pre-existing code used remain the property of CORE829 SRL and are licensed to the client for the use of the deliverable.

sections.title: 9. Confidentiality
sections.body: Both parties undertake to keep confidential all business, technical and personal information exchanged during the negotiations and the execution of the services, and to use it only for the purpose of the agreement. This obligation survives the termination of the agreement.

sections.title: 10. Custom Servers — specific terms
sections.body:
CORE829 does not manufacture or ship hardware directly: it designs the build, selects components through its partner ecosystem (including Intel and NVIDIA), coordinates production and verifies quality before delivery. Delivery is available only within Europe and America; orders for other regions cannot be processed.
Hardware is covered by the manufacturer's warranty, as passed on to the client. CORE829 is not a party to the manufacturer's warranty but provides reasonable assistance in exercising it.

The website and the services are provided with the due professional diligence. To the maximum extent permitted by law, CORE829 SRL shall not be liable for indirect, incidental, consequential or punitive damages, loss of profits, loss of data or interruption of business arising from the use of the website or the services, even if advised of the possibility of such damages.
In any case, the aggregate liability of CORE829 SRL for any claim related to a project shall not exceed the total amount paid by the client for that project.

sections.title: 12. Force majeure
sections.body: Neither party shall be liable for delay or failure to perform its obligations where such delay or failure results from events beyond its reasonable control, including but not limited to natural disasters, pandemics, wars, strikes, power failures or network disruptions. The affected party shall notify the other party as soon as reasonably possible.

sections.title: 13. Termination
sections.body: Either party may terminate the agreement for convenience with written notice in accordance with the terms of the specific agreement. In case of material breach not remedied within 15 days of written notice, the aggrieved party may terminate the agreement and claim damages. Amounts due for work already performed remain payable.

sections.title: 14. Applicable law and jurisdiction
sections.body: These Terms of Service are governed by Romanian law. Any dispute arising out of or in connection with these terms or the services shall be submitted to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts of Romania.

gdpr.title: GDPR
gdpr.intro: This page provides detailed information on how CORE829 SRL processes personal data in compliance with the GDPR (EU Regulation 2016/679) and the applicable Romanian legislation on personal data protection (Law no. 190/2018).

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
sections.body: CORE829 SRL, Str. Mihai Eminescu, 10, Roman, Romania, Trade Register no. J2026029428009, CUI/CIF 54616345, is the data controller. You can contact us by email at hello@core829.net or by telephone at +40 766 668 482 / +39 375 946 8881.

sections.title: 2. Data we process
sections.body: We process the data you provide voluntarily through our contact, quote and consultation forms: name, email, company, services of interest, estimated budget and message content. During a contractual relationship we also process invoicing and billing data. We process minimal technical data (IP address, browser type, pages visited) for the security and operation of the website.

sections.title: 3. Legal basis for processing
4. Data subject rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and port your personal data, and to object to its processing. You may withdraw your consent at any time. You can exercise these rights by writing to hello@core829.net; we will respond within 30 days.

sections.title: 5. Data retention
sections.body: Personal data is retained only for the time necessary to respond to requests and manage the contractual relationship, in accordance with legal retention periods. Accounting data is kept for the periods required by law, after which it is securely deleted or anonymised.

sections.title: 6. Recipients and data processors
sections.body: Personal data may be shared, only where necessary, with hosting, email, payment and invoicing providers, professional advisors and public authorities where required by law. All processors are bound by data processing agreements in accordance with Art. 28 GDPR.

sections.title: 7. Data transfers
sections.body: We do not transfer personal data outside the European Economic Area. Where a transfer occurs through a third-party processor, appropriate safeguards under Chapter V GDPR are applied.

sections.title: 8. Automated decision-making
sections.body: We do not make decisions based solely on automated processing, including profiling, that produce legal effects concerning you or similarly significantly affect you.

sections.title: 9. Data security
sections.body: We implement technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk, including encryption of data in transit, access controls and regular reviews, in accordance with Art. 32 GDPR.

sections.title: 10. Contact and complaints
sections.body:
For any question regarding the processing of your personal data, or to exercise your rights, write to hello@core829.net.
You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Romanian supervisory authority ANSPDCP (www.dataprotection.ro) or with the supervisory authority of your place of residence.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: This Cookie Policy explains what cookies are and how CORE829 SRL uses cookies and similar technologies on the website core829.net, in accordance with the GDPR and the ePrivacy Directive, as transposed into Romanian law.

sections.title: 1. What are cookies
sections.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow the website to remember your preferences and to understand how visitors use the site, improving functionality and user experience.

sections.title: 2. Cookies we use
3. Third-party cookies
sections.body: Some cookies are set by third-party services integrated into the website, such as the Trustpilot review widget and analytics platforms. These third parties may process the data collected according to their own privacy policies.

sections.title: 4. Managing cookies
sections.body: You can manage or delete cookies through your browser settings. Blocking certain cookies may affect the functionality of the website, such as remembering your language preference.

sections.title: 5. Consent
sections.body: Where cookies are not strictly necessary, we request your consent before installing them. You can change your preferences at any time by clearing your browser cookies and revisiting the website.

sections.title: 6. Changes to this policy
sections.body: This Cookie Policy may be updated from time to time. Any change will be published on this page with the updated date.

sections.title: 7. Contact
sections.body: For any question regarding the use of cookies, write to hello@core829.net.
